vulnerability_title: [M-11] No slippage protection on Uniswap swap

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: The concentrated-liquidity overload of _performSwap sets amountOutMinimum to 1, and the Balancer overload at the linked line passes a limit of 0. Neither swap has a real minimum output.
issues: The swap goes through a Slipstream router, not a Uniswap router as the title says. Any oracle check in the BuyBackBurner base contract is not in this file.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: swap without a minimum output amount
